_comment: The mainnet pool, as a template. The LIVE file is pool/config-mainnet.json
on the pool host: same numbers, real RPC and Redis credentials, 0600, and
git-ignored so it can never be committed by accident.
This copy exists because the live one existed in exactly one place. Every
number below is a policy decision -- the fee, the PPLNS window multiplier,
the minimum payout, the reserve kept for transaction fees, how many
recipients one payment batch may carry -- and losing the machine meant
retyping them from memory on the worst possible night.
user and password are the placeholder 't', the same convention
config.testnet.json uses. Nothing here is a secret.
_poolAddress: The pool's own wallet address. Every block reward (minus the consensus treasury output) is paid here first, then distributed from the wallet. MUST start with 'W' on mainnet.
_coinbaseSignature: Vanity string embedded in every block this pool mines. Keep it short: the whole scriptSig is capped at 100 bytes.
_poolFeePercent: The OPERATOR's fee, taken after the chain's 5% treasury output. These are two entirely separate fees; miners see 5% + this.
_pplnsMultiplier: PPLNS window = multiplier x network difficulty. 2 is the industry norm.
_maxPaymentRecipients: Outputs in one payment transaction. A sendmany carrying a few thousand outputs crosses the 100 kB standard-transaction limit and every node drops it, so the pool would retry the same oversized payment for ever and nobody would be paid at all. Whatever does not fit keeps its balance and goes out on the next run.
_maxWamPerPaymentBatch: Ceiling on the value of one payment transaction. Not a technical limit -- transaction size depends on the number of outputs, not the amount -- but it bounds what a single mistake or a single compromised run can move.
_randomxFullMemory: false = light mode, 256 MiB, correct for a VERIFYING pool. true = 2 GiB per live seed; only useful if this process also mines.

daemons._wallet: The wamd wallet that holds poolAddress. Required whenever the node has more than one wallet loaded: without it every payout RPC returns 'wallet file not specified' and miners are never paid, on a pool that otherwise looks perfectly healthy. The pool refuses to start unless this wallet owns poolAddress.
